page.layout: One column of running text on one printed page. No marginal notes. Running head at the top, page number at the top left, catchword at the lower right.

main_text.l: in his coactus sit fateri, Christum esse unum
illum Deum, qui omnia creavit; aut certe ex illi-
us propria substantia genitum; atque adeo non
esse Creaturam, nudumque Hominem, qui non ex-
titit, antequam ex B. V. Maria natus esset; (quod
alibi toties affirmat, variisque Argumentis,
quantum
in se est, propugnat) sed etiam,
& multo
magis, quod hoc afferere cogatur ex Authorita-
te veterum Ecclesiae Doctorum, qui (ut verissi-
me inquit) nimis aperte in S. Scriptura ea Chri-
sto tribui animadverterunt, quae soli Deo tribui
consueverunt; &, inter caetera, potissimum Ado-
rationem & Invocationem. Unde & Eum obnixe
rogat, ne manifestissimae Veritati quicquam re-
pugnare velit. Porro, constet modo sibi Socinus
Illiusque Discipuli Magistri sui Dictatis ausculta-
re velint, ut ad eandem Regulam caetera sua Dog-
mata examinari patiantur, riteque sic examinata
ad Illam conformentur, neque aliud, neque ampli-
us quidquam ab eis petimus. Sed quis non vi-
det, ex hoc Concessio[?], totum Socinianismum illico
ruiturum, & abolitum iri ex Ecclesia; nimirum
si Interpretatio S. Scripturae ab antiquis Patribus al-
lata, qui Fidem Christianam Pietate simul ac Doctrina
adornarunt, & Martyrio insuper confirmarunt,
pro vera & Authentica accipienda sit; & si Om-
nes Interpretationem eam oppugnantes, in manife-
stissima Veritate oculos claudant.
§. 4o.[?] Inter hic advertere lubet, ad quas
astru-angustias redactus fuerit Socinus, cum ad Scrip-
turam solam appellaret in Dogmatibus suis astru-
endis; nempe, ad Scripturam suo Ipsius sensu ex-
positam, seu potius, in Eum detortam. Quippe

page.notes: Printed page 58 with running head. The right edge of the scan shows only the neighbouring page and show-through, which are left out. The reading "Concessio" is doubtful (the scan looks like "Conceslo"). The section number "4o." is hard to read. The catchword "juscunque" is at the lower right. The hyphenated words "Chri-sto", "astru-endis" and "manife-stissima" are kept with their printed hyphens, but in the final paragraph the ending "astru-" was misplaced: the scan reads "ad quas angustias ... suis astru-endis", which is transcribed above with the hyphen at the line end.
